Name: (CPxAT) Jona's Potted Strawberry
Author: JonaChu
Description:
这个盆栽草莓有漂亮的开花阶段和青涩果实阶段，它的盆由柳条编织。

[size=4][b]获取方法：[/b][/size]
[b]第二年以及之后年份[/b]的[b]彩蛋节[/b]，在皮埃尔的摊位购买种子。

[b]生长周期[/b]：和原版草莓一致。(8天长成，4天重复收获)
价格比原版的草莓更高，因为产量更高（每株盆栽草莓在每次收获时可获得2~4颗草莓，只要保证能收获两次，就比原版赚的多）。

一直很想画一些从盆边垂下的草莓，在看过一些栽培草莓的参考图片之后，更是被它们漂亮的小白花迷住了。
因此有了这个模组！

最开始是想直接替换原版的草莓作物，不过我发现除非是啤酒花那样的棚架作物，否则浇水会让整个盆变成很诡异的浇湿颜色。

我给原版的草莓也画了替换纹理，所以决定将盆栽草莓作为新作物添加。

这些盆栽草莓相当可爱，希望你也能喜欢它！

[size=3][b]可选文件：[/b][/size]
对原版草莓的重新纹理。CP版本可配置。

[size=4]翻译：[/size]
该模组包含中文和英文。

These potted strawberries feature beautiful flowering and unripe fruit stages, showcased in woven wicker pots.

[size=4][b]How to obtain：[/b][/size]
[size=2]Purchase seeds from Pierre’s shop stall at the [b]Egg Festival[/b] in [b]Year 2 and beyond.[/b]

[b]Growth Cycle:[/b] Same as vanilla.(8 days to mature, with a 4-day regrowth cycle)
They are priced higher than vanilla strawberries due to their increased yield (each potted plant produces 2–4 strawberries per harvest; as long as you manage at least two harvests, they are more profitable than the vanilla version).

[/size]I’ve always wanted to draw strawberries draping over the edges of their pots. After looking through some reference photos of strawberry cultivation, I was especially captivated by their beautiful tiny white flowers.
And so, this mod was born!

Initially, I planned to simply replace the vanilla strawberry sprites. However, I noticed that unless it's a trellis crop (like hops), watering would cause the entire pot to turn a strange, "soaked" color.
Since I’ve also designed a retexture for the vanilla strawberries, I decided to implement these potted versions as an entirely new crop instead.

These potted strawberries are quite cute, and I hope you enjoy them too!

[size=3][b]Optional files:[/b][/size]
Retextured the vanilla strawberry. Configurable in the CP version.

[size=4]Translation：[/size]
Chinese and English included.
